items.title: Fairview sues UnitedHealthcare over 2027 Medicare plan info - Star Tribune
items.reason: This is a direct provider lawsuit against a major payer (UnitedHealthcare) over Medicare plan information, which falls squarely within payer litigation enforcement topics.
items.summary: Fairview Health Services has filed a lawsuit against UnitedHealthcare regarding information related to the payer's 2027 Medicare plans, according to the Star Tribune. While specific details about the claims and relief sought are not provided in the excerpt, this litigation involves a major health system challenging a national payer over Medicare plan-related matters. The lawsuit is relevant to revenue-cycle teams as it may address network inclusion, plan design changes, payment terms, or other issues affecting provider contracting and reimbursement for Medicare beneficiaries in upcoming plan years.
